title: Geometric clocks on causal graphs
html: Marzke–Wheeler axiomatic relativity and geometric clocks for causal graphs generated by hypergraph rewriting, and the set-theoretic structure that connects them to the rewriting systems.

title: Insertion Lie brackets for hypergraphs
html: Lie and Poisson structures on hypergraphs, towards a Hamiltonian formalism for hypergraph rewriting.

title: Discrete difference operators on graphs
html: Discrete analogues of differential operators on graphs and hypergraphs, the starting point for several further developments in discrete differential geometry.
